name: stepper

frames.best_why: Shows two completed ticks, an active numbered step and both navigation buttons enabled.

tagline: Numbered steps turn into ticks as you page through a short flow.
summary: A four-step progress path: each step is a small numbered circle above a bold title and a muted description, with Back and Next buttons underneath. Reaching a step fills the previous circle into a tick.
appearance: Four evenly spaced steps across a black stage, each a small circle above a bold label and a dim line of text. Completed circles are white with a dark tick, the current one is white with its number, the rest stay grey; two small buttons sit centred beneath.
behaviour: Clicking Next fills the current circle with a tick and lights the next step, Back reverses it, and clicking a circle jumps straight to that step. Both buttons dim when they reach either end.
demo_content: Four steps: Account, Profile, Review and Done, with lines such as 'Create your account' and 'All set!'.
search_phrases: numbered steps for a signup flow
use_when: A short linear flow needs its position and finished steps visible at a glance.
avoid_when: Four titles with descriptions need width, so a narrow screen would crowd the row badly.
customise: Compose items, triggers, indicators, titles, descriptions and separators; orientation, active value and per-step loading or disabled are props.
weight_why: Four small circles and labels with short scale transitions.

a11y.note: Each step is a real button with text and a focus ring, but the current step is shown by numbering and colour only.

issues: The connector lines between circles vanish against the black background
On the first step the Back button is so faint it can hardly be seen
polish_why: Clear numbered progress with tidy ticks; the step connectors disappear on the black stage.
title: Stepper
